$comment: KDP rules for Volume. Built only from docs/reference-kdp-facts-2026-10-03.md (official pages read on 3 October 2026). Never edit this file after release: add a new dated file instead (see README.md). Quotes are normalised to plain hyphens, so a dash in a quote may differ from the page.

statusKey.confirmed: Seen on the official page named in source.
statusKey.partial: Official page found, but the exact detail was not shown, was only in a search summary, or was inconsistent. Show a check-before-use warning.
statusKey.unverified: Not in the facts file. Do not use for calculations or print it as fact until someone checks the official page and adds a new dated file.

rules.unit: fraction of list price excluding VAT
rules.note: 35% of list price without VAT, or 70% of list price without VAT less delivery costs. 70% applies only to sales in eligible territories; 35% applies elsewhere. Public domain works can only use 35%.

Order of deductions: VAT and delivery cost are taken off the list price before the rate is applied. KDP's worked example: 0.70 x (EUR 1.99 - EUR 0.08 - EUR 0.10) = EUR 1.27. For 35%, deliveryCost is 0. Replaces the looser wording of 2.1.

workedExample.description: Our sum, not KDP's: 2 MB eBook at GBP 2.99 on amazon.co.uk at 70%

rules.note: The 70% option on amazon.co.uk needs a list price in this band. The EU/UK price page labels it 'minimum and maximum list price with VAT' and dates the range 'as of July 7, 2026'. Second source: https://kdp.amazon.com/en_US/help/topic/G201645450
amazon.co.uk price range at 35% depends on the eBook file size.
Quote: 'Amazon.co.uk: UK GBP 0.10/MB' (currency symbol written out). Deducted on 70% sales only.

UK eBook VAT has been 0% since 1 May 2020. KDP calculates royalties on the price after any applicable VAT. KDP describes EU/UK eBook list prices as VAT-inclusive; with UK VAT at 0% the effect on a UK price is nil. Do not say more than that. Second source: https://kdp.amazon.com/en_US/help/topic/G200644210

Free 90-day programme for Kindle eBooks only, exclusive to the Kindle Store for the term, renews automatically unless you opt out. Print and audio can be sold elsewhere. KU pays from the Global Fund by KENP read, capped at 3,000 KENP per title per customer (fact 2.7, https://kdp.amazon.com/en_US/help/topic/G201541130). Countdown Deals run only on amazon.com and amazon.co.uk (fact 2.8).

A newly published eBook cannot run a Countdown Deal in its first 30 days. PARTIAL sub-detail: a Countdown Deal and a Free Book Promotion probably cannot both run in the same enrolment period (fetch summary, not quoted word for word). Marketplaces from fact 2.8.
Paperback royalties on amazon.co.uk are tiered, not a flat 60%. The page does not give the date the tiering started.
Expanded Distribution pays 40% of list price minus printing costs.

rules.formula: printingCost = flat (low band) or fixed + pages x perPage (high band)
rules.note: Caution: the page returned the bands as '24 - 110' and '110 - 828', which overlap at 110 pages; check the live table before relying on the boundary. The large-trim page bands were not stated in the facts file; check them before use. KDP's worked example: a 55-page black-ink book costs GBP 1.93. Our sum, not KDP's: 200-page 6 x 9 in black ink = 0.85 + 200 x 0.010 = GBP 2.85.

So that 'your royalties earned are always enough to cover the cost to print your book'. Use the rate of the tier the resulting price falls in (3.1): compute with 0.6, and if the result is GBP 7.98 or less, recompute with 0.5.

rules.value: list price is VAT-exclusive; Amazon adds VAT
rules.note: Most UK books are at 0%, but notebooks, planners and books with bonus content can be at 20%. 'Your royalties are not impacted by VAT rate variations.' Relevant to the workbook template.
6 x 9 in is 'the most common trim size for paperbacks in the U.S.'. Maximum pages depend on trim, ink and paper (590 to 828). Second source: https://kdp.amazon.com/en_US/help/topic/G201857950

Not in the facts file: written from general knowledge so the trim picker has options. Check KDP's trim size table (and the per-trim page maximums and which trims count as 'large') before phase 1 ships the picker, then add a new dated file.
Interior bleed: add 0.125 in to the width (outside edge only) and 0.25 in to the height (0.125 in top and bottom).

One PDF with back cover, spine and front cover, 0.125 in (3.2 mm) bleed on all outer edges, images at least 300 DPI. KDP's cover calculator (https://kdp.amazon.com/cover-calculator) takes binding, ink, paper, trim, units and page count and gives exact dimensions plus a template. Phase 4 acceptance compares Volume's wrap sizes to it.
Black ink on white paper 0.002252 in per page; cream paper 0.0025 in per page. Colour paper is not in the facts file.

The page says both 'at least 79 pages' and 'more than 79 pages'; Cover Creator needs 80. Volume uses 80 to be safe: no spine text below 80 pages. Covers with spine text on books under 79 pages are rejected.

Not in the facts file. Values written from general knowledge so export has a placeholder table. Check KDP's 'Set trim size, bleed, and margins' guide before phase 1 export ships, then add a new dated file with factId and verifiedOn. Preflight must warn while this rule is unverified.

values.position: back cover, lower right, inside the safe area

rules.note: Not in the facts file. Keep-out box for the barcode KDP prints when no barcode is supplied. Size and position written from general knowledge; check KDP's paperback cover guide and the cover calculator template before phase 4, then add a new dated file.
Not in the facts file. Safe distances for cover text from the trim edge and spine edges, from general knowledge. Check the KDP cover guide before phase 4.
Hardcovers are available on KDP, including amazon.co.uk. Not a v1 export target.
PNG is not in the listed file types: export the eBook cover as JPEG (or TIFF). The eBook cover is a front-cover image uploaded separately from the paperback cover PDF.

Volume never generates an ISBN. The ISBN field is filled by the owner (from KDP or Nielsen) or left empty. eBook ISBN optional (4.2). Low-content books not eligible for the free ISBN (4.3, PARTIAL). Each format needs its own ISBN (10.3).

Paperback list and bleed rule from fact 6.2 (https://kdp.amazon.com/en_US/help/topic/G201857950). MOBI no longer accepted for fixed-layout eBooks from March 2025. KDP advises saving print PDFs with fonts embedded (6.6).

avoid: time-sensitive words such as 'new' or 'on sale'

rules.note: Up to seven keywords or short phrases. No exact character limit per box is stated on the page.
'You can select 3 categories when creating a book in KDP.' Category names must be picked in KDP's own chooser; the AI only suggests.
HTML tags count towards the 4,000 characters (confirmed again in 10.14).

The formatting list is confirmed. The exact tag spellings in assumedTags (for example b versus strong) were not in the facts file; the checker should allow them but the owner should check the page before relying on strong or em.
'Your title and subtitle together must be fewer than 200 characters.' Volume counts title + subtitle without the separator; if in doubt the owner should keep a margin.

values.aiGenerated: An AI tool created the actual content (text, images or translations), even if you applied substantial edits afterwards. Must be disclosed to KDP when publishing or republishing.
values.aiAssisted: You created the content yourself and used AI tools to edit, refine, error-check or otherwise improve it. 'It is not necessary to inform us.'
values.volumeDefault: ai-generated whenever Volume's AI wrote any of the text or made any of the images

rules.note: Fully automatic mode means the text is AI-generated under KDP's definition. The publishing package always includes an AI disclosure note set to AI-generated for text, and for images when the cover art came from the image model.

values: content that's typically disappointing to customers
descriptive content meant to mislead customers
undifferentiated versions of public domain titles if a free version is available in our store
rules.note: Drives the quality gates and the honest-description rules in the matter prompts.

rules.unit: titles per book format per week
rules.note: 'we limit the number of titles you can create at the same time to 2 per book format each week.' The older '3 titles per day' figure is out of date. PARTIAL sub-details: the weekly reset time (reported in search results as Sunday 00:00 UTC) and the start date were not visible on an official page. Volume mode's scheduler refuses a third new title per format per week.

'it takes 3 business days for your book (or update) to be Live on Amazon'. Paperback detail pages can take up to 5 days on other marketplaces such as amazon.co.uk. Used by the launch email and launch plan so dates are not promised too early.

values.advanceReaderCopyAllowed: a free or discounted copy is fine, but the author cannot require a review or try to influence it

rules.note: The rule covers friends and relatives generally, not only close friends. Review swaps between authors are not named but count as an exchange and a conflict of interest, so Volume never suggests them.

values.anythingElseInvalidatesReview: anything other than a free or discounted copy, including gift cards

rules.note: So the review request in the back matter asks politely for an honest review, offers nothing, and never asks for a positive one. 'A free copy in exchange for a review' is not allowed.

values.deadline: within one month beginning with the day of publication

rules.note: Duty and address confirmed (4.5); deadline from the Act (4.6, https://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/2003/28/section/4); other five libraries (4.7). NOT FOUND (4.9): whether KDP print-on-demand books printed outside the UK trigger the duty. The publishing package only reminds the owner to send a copy or ask the BL Legal Deposit Office.
